authority: README and user proceed instruction; routine collection choices delegated on 2026-10-10
limits: Goals do not guarantee feasible disjoint source allocations or pilot-estimated main precision.
Code includes every eligible unique file observed in the bounded pool, not every file in remote repositories.
Network decoder read-ahead can exceed the number of yielded rows.
An overlapping acquisition records raw asset provenance and collapses only identical document identities.
Broader article similarity and external repository-clone detection rules remain unspecified.
scientific_variant_decision: exclude both retained scientific records sharing the flagged publication URL

source_audit_scope.duplicate_content: exact UTF-8 text hashes use one seeded representative; aliases connect source groups
source_audit_scope.repository_aliases: recorded source aliases and case-folded repository names connect groups; external clone relationships absent from metadata are not claimed as checked
source_audit_scope.scientific_article_variants: recorded pdf_hash and sha1 connect known copies; distinct paper IDs sharing an exact recorded oa_url are excluded; no text-similarity threshold is claimed
source_audit_scope.source_group_disjointness: all eligible groups are assigned to one technical, probe, calibration, pilot, or main stage; excluded records do not enter a stage

source_terms_status: retained source catalog review pending; no automatic terms acceptance
stop_rule: scan the complete approved yielded-row bound or source exhaustion; no automatic scan extension
